title: The hand on the dog
logline: The last page of the sequence in the book: the garage, the pup asleep under the table, and a hand down on his back — the hand-on-the-dog of 2000, 2005 and 2015, with no man above it. The sequence ends on the hand.

panels.composition: Under the drafting table: a small three-legged dog asleep on a folded blanket, a man's hand resting on its back, the arm going up out of frame, the lamp's light from above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, beneath a drafting table a small three-legged dog asleep on a folded blanket with a man's hand resting on its back and the arm going up out of frame, lamplight from above, no words
image.notes: The hand-on-the-dog panels: 2000, 2005, 2015. This is the fourth.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The fourth hand-on-the-dog. No man above it.
